paite: Hiaite Hebron a piang David tapate ahi uh: Ata masa, Jezreel numei Ahinoam a pan Amnon; anihna, Karmel numei Abigail a pan Daniel;
heading: Kumpipa David Suante

paite: athumna, Geshur kumpipa Talmai tanu Maakah tapa a pan Absalom; alina, Haggith tapa Adonijah;
angana, Abital a pan Shephatiah; agukna, azi Eglah a pan Ithream.
Hebron ah atapa gukte apiang ua; huai ah kum sagih leh kha guk vai ahawm hi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum leh kum thum vai ahawm hi.
Hiaite Ammiel tanu Bath-shua lak a Jerusalem a piang lite ahi uh: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, leh Solomon.
Adang kuate Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet;
Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia;
Elishama, Eliada, leh Eliphelet ahi uh.
Hiaite tengteng, ameite tapate chih louh, David tapate ahi uh; huan asanggamnu uh Tamar ahi.
Huan Solomon tapa Rehoboam ahi. Atapa Abia, atapa Asa, atapa Jehoshaphat,
heading: Kumpipa Solomon Suante

paite: atapa Joram, atapa Ahaziah, atapa Joash;
atapa Amaziah, atapa Azariah, atapa Jotham;
atapa Ahaz, atapa Hezekiah, atapa Manasseh;
atapa Ammon, atapa Josiah.
Josiah tapate: ata masa Johanan, anihna Jehoiakim, athumna Zedekiah, alina Shallum.
Jehoiakim tapate: Jekoniah atapa leh Zedekiah atapa ahi uh.
Huan salmatpa Jekoniah suante: Atapa Salathiel,
heading: Jekoniah Suante

paite: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, leh Nedabiah.
Pedaiah tapate: Zerubbabel leh Shimei ahi. Zerubbabel tapate: Meshullam leh Hananiah ahi; asanggamnu uh Shelomith ahi:
Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah, leh Jusa-hesed, nga ahi uh.
Huan Hananiah tapate: Pelatiah leh Jeshaiah ahi; Rephaiah tapate, Arnan tapate, Obadiah tapate, Shekaniah tapate.
Shekaniah tapa Shemaiah ahi. Huan Shemaiah tapate: Hattush, Igeal, Bariah, Neariah, leh Shaphat, guk ahi uh.
Neariah tapate: Elioenai, Hizkiah, leh Azrikam, thum ahi uh.
Elioenai tapate: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Dalaiah, leh Anani, sagih ahi uh.
